The "Guideline Recommendation" topic encompasses formal clinical directives designed to standardize and improve patient care protocols. Within the provided corpus, this topic is primarily anchored by the recommendations from [[afdk-anbefaler|AFDK anbefaler]], which focus on the structure and content of [[patientuddannelse|Patientuddannelse]] (patient education) [^src1]. 

The guidelines emphasize that patient education should not be a one-size-fits-all approach. Instead, it must be carefully adapted to the individual patient's specific situation and the format of the educational intervention, such as whether it is delivered individually or in a group setting [^src1]. To ensure that all critical information is conveyed, the recommendation explicitly directs practitioners to include the specific information items listed in [[tabel-1|Tabel 1]] during these educational sessions [^src1]. This ensures a comprehensive, tailored, and standardized approach to patient education across different clinical scenarios.

## Claims
- AFDK anbefaler at patientundervisningen bør indeholde informationer listet i nedenstående tabel tilpasset den enkelte patients situation og den form for undervisning man gennemfører (individuel, hold) [^src1] (afdk-anbefaler, patientuddannelse, tabel-1)
